help: the declared flip (#458): reads the PR and refuses anything not OPEN, a body with no 'aims to complete #N' to flip, a title that copies no aimed issue's title (#479), or an aimed issue whose open blocker the body does not aim to complete (#482); relocates once onto the base only if it moved (rsc/test/ conflicts are the syntactic class, taken wholesale and re-derived by the gate; any other conflict aborts back to review), resyncs a clean checkout that holds the branch and says so, then flips the body's phrasing to closes - commits are never rewritten and never come to carry the parser's words, and the last word is one verdict: forge flip: DONE naming what flipped, or NOT DONE naming the halt

args.name: pr
args.help: the PR to flip: a number, a URL, or a branch

gh pr view: reads the PR's state, base and head before anything else, its body for the phrase to flip, and its title for the copy check
gh issue view: reads each aimed issue's title (#479): a title that copies none of them refuses the flip before any enacting step
gh api: reads each aimed issue's open blockers (#482): a body that leaves one unaimed refuses the flip before any enacting step
git fetch origin <base> <head>: reads both refs to judge whether the base moved
git push --force-with-lease: WRITES the relocated head back to the PR, leased against the sha the flip read - only when the base had moved (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
gh pr edit --body-file: WRITES the flipped body: every 'aims to complete #N' becomes 'closes #N' (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
